idea-plugin.name: Dead Code & Drift Radar
idea-plugin.description:
Dead Code & Drift Radar — Find Forgotten Code Before It Becomes Debt

Identify abandoned, drifting, and dead code in your project using git history and static analysis. Every file gets a drift score (0-100) so you know exactly what's actively maintained and what's rotting.

Core Features

  • Drift Score — 0-100 health metric combining git history and reference analysis
  • Gutter Icons — Color-coded indicators (🟢 Active, 🟡 Drifting, 🔴 Abandoned)
  • Hover Tooltips — Author, last change, reference count, and drift breakdown
  • Project View Badges — See drift status without opening files
  • Configurable Thresholds — Define your own standards for drift boundaries

Pro Features ($3.90/month)

  • Method-level drift scores
  • Project heatmap visualization
  • Trend analysis and cleanup backlog
  • Zombie and orphan code detection
  • Safe-to-remove confidence scores
  • Export reports (SARIF, JUnit XML)
  • CI integration via Gradle task

Requirements

  • IntelliJ IDEA 2024.1+ (or any JetBrains IDE)
  • Git repository

Support

Documentation | Issue Tracker | Contact Support

idea-plugin.change-notes:
What's New

  • Drift Score Analysis - Calculates a 0-100 health metric for every file based on git history and code references
  • Visual Gutter Icons - Color-coded indicators (green/yellow/red) showing code freshness directly in the editor
  • Hover Tooltips - Detailed information on author, last change date, reference count, and drift factors
  • Project View Badges - File-level drift status visible in the project explorer
  • Git History Analysis - Tracks modification frequency, last modified dates, and contributor activity
  • Reference Counting - Identifies incoming usages and call sites for each code element
  • Configurable Thresholds - Customize drift score boundaries to match your team's standards
  • Method-Level Granularity (Pro) - Drift scores for individual methods, not just files
  • Project Heatmap (Pro) - Visual heatmap showing drift hotspots across your entire project
  • Export Reports (Pro) - Generate SARIF and JUnit XML reports for CI integration
